topic: CIRT and CANTOS trials: methotrexate and canakinumab for cardiovascular inflammation

source.title: Targeting Inflammation to Reduce Residual Cardiovascular Risk
source.whyItFits: Stored abstract names CANTOS and CIRT, the populations enrolled, canakinumab's MACE result, and the early stop of low-dose methotrexate for lack of benefit.
